```{r setup}
library(pkgreviewtest)
library(dplyr)
```

## Overview

This article shows a short exploration of the water point observations in
the `pkgreviewtest` dataset.

## Water points by status

```{r}
pkgreviewtest |>
  count(status)
```

## Users per water source

```{r}
pkgreviewtest |>
  group_by(waterSource) |>
  summarise(mean_users = mean(users_count))
```
